lines: Main jaanta hoon jo woh likhenge jawaab mein
couplets.en: I know what they will write in reply.

lines: Kab se hoon, kya bataaun, jahaan-e-kharaab mein
couplets.en: How can I tell how long I have lived in this ruined world?

lines: Shab-ha-e-hijr ko bhi rakhoon gar hisaab mein
couplets.en: And what if I count the nights we spent apart?

lines: Mujh tak kab unki bazm mein aata tha daur-e-jaam
couplets.en: When did the cup ever reach me as it went round their gathering?

lines: Saaqi ne kuchh mila na diya ho sharaab mein
couplets.en: Could the cupbearer have slipped something into the wine?

lines: Taa phir na intizaar mein neend aaye umr bhar
couplets.en: So I would lie awake waiting for the rest of my life.

lines: Aane ka ahd kar gaye, aaye jo khwaab mein
couplets.en: They came in a dream and left me with a promise to come.

lines: Ghalib, chhuti sharaab, par ab bhi kabhi kabhi
couplets.en: Ghalib, I gave up wine, though now and then I still have a drink.

lines: Peeta hoon roz-e-abr o shab-e-mahtaab mein
couplets.en: I drink on cloudy days and moonlit nights.

lines: Kab se hoon, kya bataaun, jahaan-e-kharaab mein
couplets.en: How can I tell how long I have lived in this ruined world?

lines: Shab-ha-e-hijr ko bhi rakhoon gar hisaab mein
couplets.en: And what if I count the nights we spent apart?
